acquisition_method.evidence: Product ion spectra were recorded in a data dependent fashion in the OT at resolution 30000.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Andromeda searches allowed oxidation of methionine residues (16 Da) and acetylation of the protein N-terminus (42 Da) as dynamic modifications and the static modification of cysteine (57 Da, alkylation with iodoacetamide).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Tryptic digests were then desalted on Pierce™ C18 Spin columns according to the manufacturer’s guidelines.

collision_energy.evidence: fragmentation was achieved by Higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy set to 32%).

enrichment_method.evidence: Phospho peptide enrichment for Mass Spectrometry Protein samples were first digested following the SP3 (single-pot, solid-phase-enhanced sample-preparation) protocol published by Hughes et al in 2019 (doi: 10.1038/s41596-018-0082-x).

fragmentation_method.evidence: fragmentation was achieved by Higher-energy C-trap dissociation (HCD) (normalized collision energy set to 32%).

instrument.evidence: MS Experiments were performed on an Orbitrap LUMOS instrument (Thermo) coupled to an EASY-nLC 1200 ultra-performance liquid chromatography (UPLC) system (Thermo).

ionization_type.evidence: attached to a nanospray flex ion source (Thermo).

labeling.evidence: inferred: The quantification is based on the “value at maximum” of the extracted ion current.

mass_analyzer.evidence: The instrument type in Andromeda searches was set to Orbitrap and the precursor mass tolerance was set to ±20 ppm (first search) and ±4.5 ppm (main search).
